q.en: How do you manage nut allergies and children's dietary requirements?

a.en: Parents record each child's allergies directly in your Managevent digital invitation RSVP. Every allergen is tracked individually and never merged into 'other', so catering and cakes are prepared safely.

q.en: Do your kids' party entertainers hold Working with Children Checks?

a.en: Yes. Every children's entertainer and on-site crew member assigned to a kids' event holds a current WA Working with Children Check (WWCC).
